behavior: Selecting slots alone does not hold them. Book Now creates an authoritative server hold and shows the remaining 15-minute window.
Details Next validates locally; Payment Method Next opens policy. Explicit acceptance saves customer details and promotes the same capability before payment.
Retries, refresh and policy completion preserve the same booking and deadline. Expired or cancelled holds cannot continue.

Expired rotated or deleted normal access blocks completed status and both retry paths without disclosure

Private hashed-IP limiter caps new holds while idempotent retries stay reusable

limits: Browser booking flows use simulated backend responses; real database integration was checked in rollback-only fixtures. No live payment or successful production booking was created for verification.
Per-IP throttling assumes the gateway supplies trusted forwarded IP headers; Turnstile and tenant/capability checks are enforced independently.

popupOrderFix.change: Book Now hides Details during security/hold creation, shows the server-confirmed countdown introduction, then Details. Existing holds reopen with remaining-time introduction. Failed requests expose a separate retry screen.
